request: Create meaningful headroom for future features while keeping current content
kept: Inlined the single room-construction call and removed unused starter-only action/weapon state writes.
Decoupled player and control specialization from enemy animation, biome pools, themed art and attack sequences.
Applied compatible runtime optimizations individually; ring volleys and live enemy pools retain their necessary general paths.
Fixed sequenced rosters so ordinary swarm, conga, kamikaze, mage and medusa behavior, formations and gaze rendering continue to work.

extension_probes.method: Write-free quick builds of the complete standalone HTML. Each probe changes only the listed catalog capability; no probe content was added to the playable game. Deltas include the packer and decoder. Existing-art examples do not include the cost of new artwork or an entirely new behavior implementation.

validation: 39 seeded current-game runs: exact pixels, atlas and audio
Animated, biome-restricted and sequenced extension builds: exact pixels and audio against their general-code versions across four seeds each
All-animated, theme-stride and ring extension builds: boot and simulation across three seeds each
Actual in-app browser: dungeon entry, rendering and input checked; no console errors
rejected_experiments: Cached spell geometry and alternative field traversal did not create worthwhile complete-file savings; approximate corner-only collision was not retained.
Shared enemy steering, cached line of sight, selection helpers and object-spawn helpers produced no substantial savings.
Alternative decoder precision, extra substring abbreviations, contextual mixing banks, backoff prediction and LZP preprocessing did not beat the shipped representation by a useful net amount.
